_doc: Every stat a node, affix or item can grant. fmt: flat '+{v}', pct '+{v}%'. Names are what tooltips show.

life_pct.name: Increased Maximum Life
life_pct.desc: Increases maximum life by this share.

life_on_kill.name: Life gained on Kill
life_on_kill.desc: Life restored when you kill an enemy.

oil_on_kill.name: Oil gained on Kill
oil_on_kill.desc: Oil restored when you kill an enemy.

armour.name: Armour
armour.desc: Armour stops part of every blunt hit; bigger hits get through more.

armour_pct.name: Increased Armour
armour_pct.desc: Increases your armour by this share.

dusk_res.name: Dusk Resistance
dusk_res.desc: Cuts Dusk damage by this share (cap 75%).

attack_speed_pct.name: Increased Attack Speed
attack_speed_pct.desc: Wickbolt and other attacks cast faster.

sunfire_pct.name: Increased Sunfire Damage
sunfire_pct.desc: Increases all sunfire damage (nearly all of yours).

spell_pct.name: Increased Spell Damage
spell_pct.desc: Increases spell damage (Flare, Moth Swarm, Noon...).

added_sunfire.name: Added Sunfire Damage
added_sunfire.desc: Flat sunfire added to every hit.

crit_chance.name: Critical Strike Chance
crit_chance.desc: Chance for a hit to crit.

crit_multi.name: Critical Strike Multiplier
crit_multi.desc: How hard a crit hits (200% = double).

light_radius_pct.name: Increased Light Radius
light_radius_pct.desc: A wider pool of Light around you.

light_loss_reduction.name: Less Light lost when Hit
light_loss_reduction.desc: Less Light lost when you are hit.

damage_vs_shrouded_pct.name: Increased Damage against Shrouded enemies
damage_vs_shrouded_pct.desc: More damage to enemies outside every light.

blazing_pct.name: Increased Damage while Blazing
blazing_pct.desc: More damage while your lantern is Blazing.

area_pct.name: Increased Area
area_pct.desc: Bigger areas for Flare and the like.

burn_chance.name: Chance to Ignite on Hit
burn_chance.desc: Chance for a hit to ignite (60% of it as burning over 2 s).
